description: This file contains asynchronous functions and helper methods for fetching and caching GitHub user profile insights, including total stars and top languages, using SQLAlchemy ORM and external GitHub API client.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: ORM model representing a GitHub user profile in the database.

classes.name: ActivityLog
classes.description: ORM model for logging user search activities and request latencies.

methods.name: _compute_total_stars
methods.description: Calculates the total number of stars across a list of repositories.

methods.name: _compute_top_languages
methods.description: Counts and returns the most common programming languages used in repositories.

methods.name: get_profile_insights
methods.description: Main asynchronous function to retrieve, cache, and update GitHub profile insights.
